explanation: December 2012 closed a cycle of the Long Count calendar called a b'ak'tun, about 394 years long. Maya inscriptions mention dates thousands of years later.

claims.text: No ancient Maya source predicts that the world would end in 2012.
On 21 December 2012 a b'ak'tun, a cycle of the Maya Long Count calendar, came to an end.
A b'ak'tun is 144,000 days, about 394 years.
Maya inscriptions, such as one at Palenque, refer to dates thousands of years after 2012.
